floater.name: floater_sk_navmesh
floater.title: Navmesh console
floater.floater.string: The census has not run yet.
Nothing is switched on; tick a layer below, or Draw the navmesh.

check_box.label: Draw the navmesh
check_box.name: overlay_on
check_box.tool_tip: The same switch as Develop > Render Metadata > Navmesh. The layers below draw whether or not the surface is drawn

check_box.label: Build faces, ledges and run-off
check_box.name: build_raster
check_box.tool_tip: Every tile keeps its solid raster's wall faces, the ledges its floors end in and the run-off down them: the surfaces snow, rain and puddles settle on and drain along

check_box.label: Walls, cover and ledges
check_box.name: show_walls
check_box.tool_tip: Floor edges by what lies beyond them, with the cover they give and where a drop lands. Draws without the navmesh surface

check_box.label: Ledges and run-off
check_box.name: show_runoff
check_box.tool_tip: Where the floors weather settles on end over a drop, and where it runs off them. Needs them built

check_box.label: Wall faces
check_box.name: show_faces
check_box.tool_tip: The vertical surfaces at their full height, which is what Atmo reads. The cover segments above stop at four metres because that is all a cover class can mean. Draws without the navmesh surface

check_box.label: Tile seams
check_box.name: show_links
check_box.tool_tip: Colour the edges where tiles meet by whether Detour joined them to the next tile. Part of the surface, so it needs Draw the navmesh

check_box.label: Spaces and portals
check_box.name: show_spaces
check_box.tool_tip: Fill each space the rooms pass cut in a colour of its own, and draw its portals: doors red, stairs lime, openings cyan, dashed where nothing is over them

check_box.label: Wind
check_box.name: show_wind
check_box.tool_tip: An arrow every 2 m over the lowest wind band near the camera, coloured by speed factor: blue calm, cyan the free stream, yellow twice it

slider.label: Heading
slider.name: overlay_wind_heading
slider.tool_tip: The heading the wind is drawn for, in degrees it blows toward, counter-clockwise from east. -1 follows the region's wind at the camera

combo_box.label: Air
combo_box.name: overlay_air
combo_box.tool_tip: The air the spaces, stamp and face offsets are built from, as floors and edges

check_box.label: X-ray vision
check_box.name: show_xray
check_box.tool_tip: Also draw what is hidden behind geometry, darker and fainter

check_box.label: Draw the world underneath
check_box.name: show_world
check_box.tool_tip: Off wipes the frame, leaving the navmesh on its own

check_box.label: Tile update blips
check_box.name: show_updates
check_box.tool_tip: A rising blip each time a tile is built or rebuilt, coloured by why, with a line back to the record that moved

slider.label: Edge width
slider.name: overlay_edge_width
slider.tool_tip: How wide the edges of the walkable surface are drawn. Some drivers refuse anything above one pixel

slider.label: Range (m)
slider.name: overlay_range
slider.tool_tip: How far from your camera the overlay is drawn; its last fifth fades away

check_box.label: Census shapes
check_box.name: show_census
check_box.tool_tip: The physics shapes the mesh is built from, and the structure each belongs to. Draws without the navmesh surface

check_box.label: Doors, ladders, shafts and vehicles
check_box.name: show_features
check_box.tool_tip: What the census has recognised: door leaves, ladder spans with the floors they can be left at, elevator shafts and vehicles

check_box.label: Physics shapes
check_box.name: physics_shapes
check_box.tool_tip: The same switch as Develop > Render Metadata > Physics Shapes: what the sim collides with

button.name: mark_button
button.label: Mark what the camera is pointing at
button.tool_tip: Cast from the middle of the screen, mark the hit, and write down everything the census and the navmesh know there. The report goes to the log under SKNavDump

button.name: export_button
button.label: Export the navmesh
button.tool_tip: Write every built mesh, tile, polygon, segment, link and face to sknavmesh-export.json in the logs folder, for reading offline

combo_box.name: capture_kind
combo_box.tool_tip: What to capture: the selected linkset or the one the camera points at with its crew, or the selected or pointed-at avatar's attachments (yourself if none)

button.name: capture_button
button.label: Export
button.tool_tip: Write triangles and each face's transparency to sknav-capture-<kind>-<id>.json in the logs folder: a vehicle in its root's frame, worn attachments each in their own root's frame, an avatar in its body frame

button.name: export_census_button
button.label: Export the census
button.tool_tip: Write what every tile is built from - the census's records, clusters, doors and features, each region's land and the build parameters - to sknav-census-<time>.json in the logs folder, so the build can be replayed offline

button.name: export_vehicle_button
button.label: Export an object and its surroundings
button.tool_tip: Write the selected linkset, or the one the camera is pointing at, with everyone sitting on it and what they wear, to sknav-object-<id>.json in the logs folder: triangles in the object's own frame and each face's transparency, plus the navmesh's collision input and the visible faces within 16 m of the point, in world axes. Pointed at an avatar sitting on nothing, it writes what they wear and the ground around where they stand

button.name: annotate_button
button.label: Annotate the navmesh...
button.tool_tip: Mark in the world where the navmesh is wrong. Both exports above carry the marks

check_box.label: Draw clusters
check_box.name: show_clusters
check_box.tool_tip: Each census cluster in the world in its own colour, its parts tinted, with whether it stands on the land and how many linksets it holds. Draws without the navmesh surface

scroll_list.name: cluster_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: The clusters within twice the overlay range, nearest first. Selecting one highlights it in the world
